protocol.name: DeepLens native single-SR Track A with independently calibrated aperture saturation
protocol.runtime: native TensorFlow1.15 CPU / Python3.7; oneDNN disabled
protocol.geometry: d=PNG8/255; s=max(d)-min(d)>0; D=(d-min)/s; Df=(focus_filename-min)/s; no depth reinversion or focus clamp
protocol.aperture: min(K*s/12.488,1); record requested and actual aperture and saturation; no extrapolation
protocol.color: Original BGR float32 [0,1], cv2.INTER_AREA half resolution; original SR uint8 intermediate preserved; final clamp/round PNG8 RGB
protocol.control_check: Fixed uniform-depth edge with remote corner depth anchor, both edge orientations and depth signs; K4/8 response, identical saturated K16/32 output; no paper-score selection
limits: User selected native single-SR and aperture saturation before formal metrics; c rounded from independent12.4879623fit to12.488.
Estimated effective K/radius derive from an approximate edge-width response, not a physically exact kernel model.
K16/32 targets exceed the measured native control range; saturation is disclosed, not removed from evaluation.
No DepthNet, GT alpha, hidden layers, training, recursive SR, aperture extrapolation or metric-based parameter selection.
Native TF1 CPU is not claimed bitwise equivalent to historical GPU execution; CPU timing is not compared to paper GPU time.
ATB private adapter may have used other input conventions or extrapolation; this implementation does not establish its identity.
